author: Master08
quote: Total waste of 100 dollars—stay far away from this complete garbage! The new developers completely ruined what made Grand Theft Auto iconic by turning it into a sanitized, woke mess. Classic features like picking up prostitutes are gone, and stealing cars or causing chaos feels heavily restricted. Only because of the great graphics, realism, and beautiful world do I have to give this 1/10. Streamers are right to call this out. Pure disappointment.
